title: Knowledge distillation: A good teacher is patient and consistent
mechanism: Function matching: teacher and student see the identical augmented view, with aggressive mixup and very long schedules.
adaptation: Online ensemble teacher on the same rot90/flip/crop/brightness view as the student, CutMix or mixup across labelled and pool cells (label-free since the teacher labels the mix), 100k steps on A6000s.
min_experiment: Arm: online function-matching KD, 100k steps, 3 seeds. Baseline: cached fixed-view KD student (Noothout arm). Metric: crack IoU / relF1@2 on CV and clean 49. Kill: below baseline or < +0.01 crack IoU.
evidence: R: ImageNet ResNet-50 student 82.8% top-1; implicit design choices (consistent views, long training) drive KD success across many vision datasets.
prior_overlap: none; CutMix only used inside Mean Teacher SSL

alt_notes.adaptation: Distil the 5-seed ensemble, our only clear win (+0.014 to +0.018 crack IoU), into one U-Net++ R34. Per-pixel KL on the same augmented view of labelled + pool cells, mixup/CutMix between cells, about 100k steps. Gives single-model deployment.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm KD-ens vs house PF single model and the 5-seed ensemble. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill if less than 50% of the single-to-ensemble gap is closed.
